What people plan most, today vs. with the tunnel

These are the four trips people have planned most often in the CrossTowner Trip Planner, not counting the example trips the planner offers as buttons. Each one shows the route and travel time today next to the same trip with the proposed CrossTowner tunnel.

How to read this page
  • Trips are ranked by the number of different visitors who planned them, then by how many times they were planned.
  • Counts cover July 21, 2026 through November 11, 2026: 686 planned trips from 123 visitors.
  • Times are station to station for a weekday 8 AM departure, from the same precomputed data as the planner. See the methodology.
